subject: Scheduling Redwood demo with NimbusHealth — DST overlap & weekly cadence
messages:
From: Sophie Chan <sophie.chan@nimbushealth.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Barker <tom.barker@nimbushealth.com>
Date: Thu, 25 Mar 2027 02:45:00 +1300
Subject: Redwood demo — proposed times (NZ morning preferred)

Hi Lauren,

Thanks again for the quick intro earlier. We’re excited to see Redwood’s inference runtime in action. Our product and infra teams are in NZ (Auckland) and prefer morning slots — range below is NZDT (UTC+13):

- Tue 30 Mar, 10:00–11:00 NZDT
- Wed 31 Mar, 09:00–10:00 NZDT

We do have one constraint: our US stakeholders (west coast) will join remotely and we want to avoid late-night local times for them. Can you confirm whether those NZ times map cleanly to a single consistent US time each week? We’re planning a weekly follow-up cadence if the demo goes well.

Also, heads up: NZ/AU have a DST transition coming up in early April — I think that will shift things by an hour; it would be great to pin down a recurring time that survives that change.

Attaching a short deck with our top priorities and a proposed .ics to make slotting easier.

Cheers,
Sophie
Sophie Chan
Head of Product, NimbusHealth
[sophie.chan@nimbushealth.com]

Attachments: nimbus-demo-slides-v1.pdf, nimbus-proposed-times.ics
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Chan <sophie.chan@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 25 Mar 2027 10:18:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Redwood demo — proposed times (NZ morning preferred)

Hi Sophie — thanks for the options and the deck.

Quick note on DST and mapping: the US (PDT) switched to DST on Mar 14 this year, and NZ (NZDT) remains UTC+13 until the first Sunday in April (Apr 4). That means the specific NZ times you proposed will map to a consistent US west-coast time for this week, but the wall-clock for US participants will shift by one hour once NZ/AU roll back/forward in April — the recurring invite needs to be set carefully to avoid a sliding window.

Marcus, Rafael — can one of you help confirm whether we should:
- create a recurring weekly invite at a fixed UTC time (preferred for consistency across DST changes), or
- set a local-time weekly invite and adjust after Apr 4?

Sophie — if you want a single concrete slot to lock for next Tue (30 Mar) that keeps US attendees reasonable, we suggest Tue 30 Mar 09:00 NZDT (which is Mon 29 Mar 14:00 PDT / Mon 29 Mar 22:00 CET). That keeps European stakeholders out of red-eye hours and US west coast at the end of their afternoon. If that works we’ll send an invite and include a note about the April DST boundary.

Best,
Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
lauren@redwood.com

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Chan <sophie.chan@nimbushealth.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 25 Mar 2027 11:05:00 +0800
Subject: Re: Redwood demo — proposed times (NZ morning preferred)

Hi Sophie — looping in scheduling + ops.

Short answer: we recommend creating the recurring series at a fixed UTC time so the meeting occupies the same absolute moment globally (less admin for everyone). I suggest:

- Recurring slot: Tuesdays 22:00 UTC starting 2027-03-30 (this corresponds to 11:00 NZDT on Wed during the NZ/AU DST flip week, but for the first meeting on 30 Mar it will show as 09:00 NZDT because of the DST boundary — we’ll include a calendar note).

If you’d rather have it display as 09:00 NZDT every week for NZ local participants we can do that, but it will move for US/EU participants when DST changes. Given you have both US and EU stakeholders, fixed-UTC recurring invites reduce confusion.

I’ll draft the calendar invite with both times in the description and attach the meeting notes + a jitter buffer.

—Marcus
Principal Solutions Engineer, Redwood
From: Sophie Chan <sophie.chan@nimbushealth.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@nimbushealth.com>, Tom Barker <tom.barker@nimbushealth.com>
Date: Thu, 25 Mar 2027 21:47:00 +1300
Subject: Re: Redwood demo — proposed times (NZ morning preferred)

Thanks Lauren and Marcus — good explanation and thanks for the UTC suggestion.

We discussed internals; priority is that NZ product folks see it in their morning and US west-coast isn’t past midnight. Fixed UTC sounds fine as long as you call out the April transition. Please go ahead and send the invite for Tue 30 Mar at the fixed UTC time you suggested and include:

- One-line note: "This is a fixed-UTC recurring meeting. NZ/AU local times will adjust after weekend of Apr 3–4 due to local DST changes."
- A link to the deck + Redwood test account info in the first invite.

We’d also like the first demo to be recorded and for the recording to be shared to the Drive link in the invite (our execs may watch asynchronously).

Appreciate it — Sophie

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
